retail_context: Grocery produce section — DB-R1 compliant/fragile fruit picking station
upper_tier_layout: Tiers at z 680 / 1040 / 1400 mm, 360 mm apart (minimum clearance 350 mm)
frame_finish: Black powder coat steel and light natural-wood crates (our own retexture)
header_back_structure: No header board or back panel, to keep the upper access clear
task_surface_geometry_id: psl.e1.produce_display_fc.task_tray@D1 (outside 1200×560, wall t15 h55, front lip 40, usable depth 530, two dividers t18, so three bays of 378 each)
upper_clearance_rule: At least 350 mm (as for the gondola; the tiers are 360 mm apart)
task_surface_physics_id: static / convexHull / μs 0.6, μd 0.5, e 0 / 30 collision pieces (0 of them proxy only)
destination_basket_rule: Shopping basket = (2.600, 0.250) / Slot_Cart_R1_Top, empty (the canonical destination). The basket does not sit on the floor: it is loaded on the top cradle of the moving cart (Slot_Floor_Cart_R1). It is a module and a slot apart from the cart, so the basket alone can be replaced.
reference_asset_source: The FC reference workbook, 01_Retail reference (embedded image image1.png), received 2026-08-18; our own parametric authoring (no UE source used)
